items.title: Ernest Roubleau Interview, 1961-10-18
items.q: I had a little cousin. He was playing with P. Ron on the roof garden.

ctx.x: Yes. And which banjo players did you like?
Did I like to be your best? Yes. Which were the best players? Well, I will tell you. I had a little cousin. He was playing with P. Ron on the roof garden.
